metadata.question: Does the snow cover in southern Siberia increase between October 14, 2018 and October 29, 2018?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Need MODIS snow cover data (MOD10A1 or MYD10A1) for southern Siberia region during Oct 14-29, 2018. 2. Masking strategy: MODIS snow cover data has a quality band, but for simplicity I'll use the NDSI snow cover band directly. 3. Logic: Compare average snow cover between two dates (Oct 14 vs Oct 29) to see if it increased. For southern Siberia, I'll define a polygon covering the region. I'll use MOD10A1.006 (Terra Snow Cover Daily) which has the 'NDSI_Snow_Cover' band. Steps: - Define southern Siberia polygon - Get MOD10A1 collection for Oct 14, 2018 and Oct 29, 2018 - Check if collections have data - Calculate mean snow cover for each date - Compare values to see if increased - Validate results (not None, reasonable range 0-100) Potential issues: - Cloud cover might affect data quality - Need to check pixel counts to ensure valid data ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const siberia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[80, 50], [100, 50], [100, 60], [80, 60], [80, 50]] ]); const date1 = '2018-10-14'; const date2 = '2018-10-29'; // 2. Data Acquisition const col1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(siberia) .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')); const col2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterBounds(siberia) .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')); const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 14 Images: ${size1}, Oct 29 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first image from each collection const img1 = col1.first(); const img2 = col2.first(); // 3. Processing - Calculate snow cover statistics const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }); const stats1 = img1.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: siberia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: siberia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean').getInfo(); const count1 = stats1.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean').getInfo(); const count2 = stats2.get('NDSI_Snow_Cover_count').getInfo(); console.log(`Oct 14: Mean=${mean1?.toFixed(2)}, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Oct 29: Mean=${mean2?.toFixed(2)}, Pixels=${count2}`); // 4. Validation & Final Answer if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Check if snow cover values are reasonable (0-100%) if (mean1 < 0 || mean1 > 100 || mean2 < 0 || mean2 > 100) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
